note: Alberta Parks recreation area campground 11 km north of Fox Creek on the North Road, run by For-Site Environmental Services for the Town of Fox Creek: two treed loops a short walk from a sandy beach, day-use area and boat launch on Iosegun Lake; kayak, paddleboard and canoe rentals. The camping loops are gated, open to registered campers only. Blue-green algae advisory in effect since July 28, 2026. --Claude
summary: Read the Alberta Parks page (updated Oct 14, 2026), the leaseholder's page and the 2017 map: 52 unserviced sites C$35 (60+ C$30), only 11 reservable by phone/text with For-Site (C$10.50 fee) from Jan 1, rest FCFS; no potable water or dump; season May 15 - Sep 30. Waterfront lakefront -> not waterfront recommended (loops 35-50+ m behind continuous forest). Policy row does not apply: policy_ref none candidate. Website and phone corrections.
flags: WATERFRONT (stored lakefront -> recommend not waterfront): map and imagery show two loops set back in forest. The North Loop's west end (sites 49-52) is ~35-50 m from the shore through continuous dense spruce; the South Loop (1-32) is 100 m+ from the lake through forest. No pad has open ground to the water and the lake is not visible from the loops on imagery. The beach and boat launch are a short walk (~100 m) from the North Loop. If AWH prefers, lakeview for 49-52 is the most the evidence allows.

POLICY ROW (provincial:AB) CONTRADICTED -> policy_ref none candidate: booking is by phone/text with the leaseholder (not shop.albertaparks.ca), opens January 1 (not a 90-day window), reservation fee C$10.50 (not C$12), and monthly/seasonal stays are sold (the row's 10-night max does not fit).
